item.title: St. Patrick’s Alex Patino records 45 points in upset win over Our Lady Academy
item.description: BILOXI, Miss. (WXXV) — St. Patrick’s Alex Patino continued her impressive season in a big way on Tuesday. The junior scored 45 points in the Lady Irish’s 72-54 upset of Our Lady Academy. That’s a career-best in a single game for Patino, and it marks one of the biggest outings in program history. item.description: GULFPORT, Miss. (WXXV) — Harrison Central High School has hired former Columbia defensive coordinator Chris Fortenberry as its next head coach. item.title: Harrison County Sheriff’s Office investigating shooting on Steeplechase Drive
item.description: HARRISON COUNTY, Miss. (WXXV)- The Harrison County Sherriff’s Office is investigating a shooting on Steeplechase Drive off of Landon Road. According to HCSO, deputies were called to the scene around 9:00pm on Wednesday. Investigators are still working to determine if there are any injuries and what may have caused the shooting. This is an ongoing investigation. Categories: Featured, Local News
